name: sportmonks_fixture
description: Match details + stats for a soccer fixture: score, participants (teams), statistics, and events. Example: sportmonks_fixture({ id: 19146701, _apiKey: "your-token" })

_apiKey.description: Sportmonks API token (get one at my.sportmonks.com; free plan = Danish/Scottish leagues)

name: sportmonks_livescores
description: Live in-play soccer matches now — current minute, state, teams, and running score. Example: sportmonks_livescores({ _apiKey: "your-token" })

_apiKey.description: Sportmonks API token (get one at my.sportmonks.com; free plan = Danish/Scottish leagues)

name: sportmonks_fixtures_by_date
description: Soccer fixtures on a date — every match scheduled/played on a given day with teams and scores. Example: sportmonks_fixtures_by_date({ date: "2026-05-24", _apiKey: "your-token" })

_apiKey.description: Sportmonks API token (get one at my.sportmonks.com; free plan = Danish/Scottish leagues)

name: sportmonks_predictions
description: Win/draw/loss prediction for a fixture — Sportmonks model probabilities for home win, draw, and away win. Example: sportmonks_predictions({ id: 19146701, _apiKey: "your-token" })

_apiKey.description: Sportmonks API token (get one at my.sportmonks.com; free plan = Danish/Scottish leagues)
